items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: I didn't know him but his son is still playing. ... I never knew him.

ctx.x: Oh look here, this is the old Peerless band. Do you recognize the guitar player there? That's Henry Kimball, and that's Bab Frank and McCurdy. And this guitar player, do you know? No, I don't know me. They have him down there as Coochie Morton there. Oh, oh yeah, I know Coochie. Does that look like him?
No, that don't look like Coochie. Coochie done changed so much the last time I yelled, I saw Coochie, you know. No, I see that, Coochie Morton. Yeah. But he was a good man though, he was a good man.
Did you hear Kimball, Henry Kimball, the old man?
